newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Sales of Teva drug good.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Sales of Teva drug good.

text.p: Preliminary figures on Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd's Copaxone sales are encouraging, but management needs to provide more details, Lehman Brothers said in a report released on Tuesday.

Lehman said the new data, provided by an auditor of prescription drug trends called IMS, showed Teva's Copaxone multiple sclerosis treatment had captured 12.9 percent of new prescriptions as of the week ended June 27. The figures support data provided by Teva management in May, Lehman added.
"Were we to include the estimated portion of the market covering home health care distribution (not tracked by IMS), we believe that Copaxone's share would be closer to 23 percent," Lehman said.
Lehman said the actual revenue data for Copaxone provided by Teva with its earnings report in August was still needed to support "what appears to be a very respectable market acceptance of the drug."

"Should management provide the level of detail on Copaxone expected by the Street, we see the stock trading up from current levels over the near term. Lack of detail (a scenario we do not envision) could result in volatility," Lehman said.
"We remain positive on the commercial prospects for Copaxone, particularly based on the argument of strong demand for an alternative to existing interferon therapies," Lehman said.
